name: Flaming Sphere Rune
disable: DC 18 Thievery check (trained) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (2rd rank; counteract DC 16) to counteract the rune

items.name: Flaming Sphere
items.text:
Trigger A living creature touches the sensor area.

---

Effect The rune detonates creating a flaming sphere in the sensor area. This is a 2nd-rank flaming sphere spell that deals 3d6 fire damage (DC 19 basic Reflex save save).

text: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 5-foot radius.
